tests.name: n2_minimal
tests.description: Edge #1: N=2 single-edge tree, no queries needed.

tests.name: n2_tight_budget
tests.description: N=2 sanity case under the standard global budget. Correct solutions may answer immediately without any queries.

tests.name: example1
tests.description: Pitfall #5: Example 1 with strict protocol validation; out-of-range node ids are rejected by the strict query handler.

tests.name: example2
tests.description: Example 2: N=4, hidden tree is star with center 1 and leaves 2,3,4.

tests.name: n3_star_center2
tests.description: N=3, star with center=2 (leaves 1 and 3). Tests non-node-1 center.

tests.name: n3_star_center3
tests.description: N=3, star with center=3 (leaves 1 and 2). Completes the N=3 topology set covering all center-node positions.

tests.name: n4_path
tests.description: Pitfall #3: N=4 path 1-2-3-4; singleton-subset queries (if attempted) always give matching size 0 and should not be treated as neighbor evidence.

tests.name: n5_path
tests.description: Pitfall #2: N=5 path 1-2-3-4-5, representative case where including known edges in sampled sets can cause edge shadowing.

tests.name: n5_star
tests.description: Edge #4: N=5 star with center=3; representative late-stage shape where one isolated node can remain to be attached. Also tests large independent-set leaves (leaves 1,2,4,5 form matching-size-0 group).

tests.name: n6_caterpillar
tests.description: N=6, caterpillar: spine 1-2-3-4, leaf 5 at node 1, leaf 6 at node 4.

tests.name: n7_bintree
tests.description: N=7, complete binary tree depth-2: root 1, children 2,3, grandchildren 4,5,6,7.

tests.name: n8_broom
tests.description: N=8, broom: path 1-2-3, then node 3 is center of star with leaves 4,5,6,7,8.

tests.name: n10_path
tests.description: Edge #3: N=10 path 1-2-3-...-10, stresses maximum path discovery.

tests.name: n10_star
tests.description: Edge #2: N=10 star with center=1 and leaves 2..10; all leaves form an independent set.

tests.name: n10_caterpillar
tests.description: N=10, caterpillar: spine 1-2-3-4-5, each spine node has one leaf (nodes 6,7,8,9,10).

tests.name: n11_component_merging
tests.description: Edge #5: N=11 branchy tree that forces repeated component merges across multiple attachment points; validates merge-driven forest updates.

tests.name: n6_zero_matching_semantics
tests.description: Edge #6: N=6 star centered at node 4; emphasizes that matching_size=0 on sampled independent sets is valid 'no-edge-in-subset' evidence, not an error signal.

tests.name: n6_protocol_strict_guard
tests.description: Pitfall #6: Strict protocol guard case under tree_matching_oracle_strict; empty subsets, duplicate node IDs, and out-of-range IDs are invalid query payloads.

tests.name: n15_adversarial_path
tests.description: Pitfall #4: N=15 path with adversarially permuted node IDs (8-3-12-6-15-1-10-4-13-7-2-11-5-14-9), useful for catching off-by-one or dropped-candidate binary-split bugs.

tests.name: n20_mixed
tests.description: N=20, mixed tree: path 1-2-3-4-5, star at node 3 with leaves 6,7,8, binary expansion at node 5 (children 9,10), node 9 with children 11,12,13, node 10 with children 14,15, and scattered leaves 16-17-18-19-20 as a path from node 1.

tests.name: n15_binary_tree
tests.description: N=15, complete 4-level binary tree: root 1, children 2,3; depth-2 nodes 4,5,6,7; depth-3 leaves 8..15.

tests.name: n12_skewed
tests.description: N=12, caterpillar/skewed tree: spine 1-2-3-4-5-6, leaves 7,8 at node 2; 9,10 at node 3; 11 at node 4; 12 at node 5.

tests.name: n9_double_star
tests.description: N=9, balanced double star: center 1 connects to sub-centers 2 and 3; node 2 has leaves 4,5,6; node 3 has leaves 7,8,9. Tests equal-length branches of depth 2 and large independent leaf sets.

tests.name: stress_n200_path
tests.description: Stress N=200 path graph: tests performance on maximum-diameter linear structure.

tests.name: stress_n200_random1
tests.description: Stress N=200 random tree (parent-assignment, seed=42): tests algorithm correctness and query count on a substantial random topology.

tests.name: n30_path
tests.description: Medium-sized N=30 path graph 1-2-3-...-30; covers the N=25-100 gap and stresses path discovery at moderate scale.

tests.name: n50_star
tests.description: Medium-sized N=50 star with center 1 and leaves 2..50; tests large independent leaf sets and repeated edge discovery from a single hub.

tests.name: n63_balanced_binary_tree
tests.description: Medium-sized N=63 complete binary tree (6 levels); tests balanced topology with many components at early discovery stages.

tests.name: n100_caterpillar
tests.description: Medium-large N=100 caterpillar: spine 1-2-...-50, each spine node i has leaf 50+i. Tests mixed degree at moderate scale.
